The premium to the second quarter of 2027 narrowed to £47/MWh from £49.05/MWh on Tuesday, as a January recovery in French nuclear availability is set to offset the UK’s heaviest month of reactor maintenance.

In France, the front-month premium to December dropped to a four-session low, as Grenoble rainfall and Paris minimum temperature forecasts for next month were revised up.
